facts.plan_summary: This is a floater health insurance plan that provides regular hospitalization benefits for families. Its main purpose is to cover medical expenses arising from hospitalization, surgeries, and related treatments for all insured family members under a single sum insured.
facts.target_customer: Families including self, spouse/live-in partner/same sex partner, dependent children (up to three), dependent parents, and dependent parents-in-law, with entry age between 18 years and 65 years.
facts.entry_age: 18 years - 65 years; Dependent children: from 16th day of birth to 25 years
facts.premium_payment_term: Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annually, Biennially (once in 2 years)
facts.premium_payment_modes: Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annually, Biennially (once in 2 years)
facts.waiting_periods: Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer. Specified disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident.
facts.free_look_period: fifteen days from date of receipt of the policy document
facts.grace_period: Grace Period of 120 days to maintain continuity of benefits without break in policy. Grace Period of 7 days would be given to pay the instalment premium due for the policy.
facts.claim_process: For cashless claims, produce the ID Card at the Hospital Helpdesk, complete and submit the Pre-authorisation Form; for reimbursement, submit claim form and supporting documents within prescribed time limits. In case of emergency hospitalization, information to be given within 24 hours after hospitalization.
facts.tax_benefits: Relief under Section 80-D: Insured Person is eligible for relief under Section 80-D of the IT Act in respect of the premium paid by any mode other than cash
key_benefits: Floater coverage for entire family under one sum insured
Hospitalization expenses including room, boarding, nursing, surgery, and specialist fees
Pre-hospitalization (up to 60 days) and post-hospitalization (up to 90 days) expenses
Automatic restoration of sum insured up to 3 times at 100% each (for SI Rs.3,00,000/- and above)
Recharge benefit providing additional indemnity if coverage is exhausted
AYUSH inpatient treatment coverage within specified limits
major_exclusions: Sub-fertility services that are deemed to be unproven, experimental or investigational
Treatment undergone for second or subsequent pregnancies except where the child from the first delivery/ previous deliveries is/are not alive at the time of treatment
Payment for services rendered to a surrogate
Costs associated with cryopreservation and storage of sperm, eggs and embryos

Star Health | Family Health Optima | Health | Section: Overview
The product provides for regular hospitalization benefits on floater basis - Who can take this insurance? Any person aged between 18 years and 65 years can take this insurance for his/her family consisting of Self, Spouse / Live in partner / Same Sex partner and dependent children not th exceeding three in number, dependent Parents and dependent Parents-in-law. Beyond 65 years, only renewals are allowed. Dependent children are covered from 16 day of its birth till expiry of the policy subject to the limits mentioned in the policy. If, at the commencement of the policy, the new born child is less than 16 days of age, the proposer can opt to cover such new born child also in the same policy by paying the applicable premium in full. However, the cover for such new born child will commence only from the 16th day of its birth and will continue till the expiry date of the policy. Maximum age limit for coverage of dependent children is 25 years.

Star Health | Family Health Optima | Health | Section: Product summary
Family Health Optima by Star Health (Health).
Plan summary: This is a floater health insurance plan that provides regular hospitalization benefits for families. Its main purpose is to cover medical expenses arising from hospitalization, surgeries, and related treatments for all insured family members under a single sum insured.
Who it is for: Families including self, spouse/live-in partner/same sex partner, dependent children (up to three), dependent parents, and dependent parents-in-law, with entry age between 18 years and 65 years.
Entry age: 18 years - 65 years; Dependent children: from 16th day of birth to 25 years
Policy term: One year / Two year
Premium payment term: Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annually, Biennially (once in 2 years)
Sum assured / sum insured: Rs.3,00,000/-, Rs.4,00,000/-, Rs.5,00,000/-, Rs.10,00,000/-, Rs.15,00,000/-, Rs.20,00,000/-, Rs.25,00,000/-; Rs.1,00,000/- and Rs.2,00,000/- (renewals only)
Premium payment modes: Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annually, Biennially (once in 2 years)
Waiting periods: Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer. Specified disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident.
Free-look period: fifteen days from date of receipt of the policy document
Grace period: Grace Period of 120 days to maintain continuity of benefits without break in policy. Grace Period of 7 days would be given to pay the instalment premium due for the policy.
Claim process: For cashless claims, produce the ID Card at the Hospital Helpdesk, complete and submit the Pre-authorisation Form; for reimbursement, submit claim form and supporting documents within prescribed time limits. In case of emergency hospitalization, information to be given within 24 hours after hospitalization.
Tax benefits: Relief under Section 80-D: Insured Person is eligible for relief under Section 80-D of the IT Act in respect of the premium paid by any mode other than cash
Key benefits: Floater coverage for entire family under one sum insured; Hospitalization expenses including room, boarding, nursing, surgery, and specialist fees; Pre-hospitalization (up to 60 days) and post-hospitalization (up to 90 days) expenses; Automatic restoration of sum insured up to 3 times at 100% each (for SI Rs.3,00,000/- and above); Recharge benefit providing additional indemnity if coverage is exhausted; AYUSH inpatient treatment coverage within specified limits
Major exclusions: Pre and Post treatment expenses; Sub-fertility services that are deemed to be unproven, experimental or investigational; Reversal of voluntary sterilization; Treatment undergone for second or subsequent pregnancies except where the child from the first delivery/ previous deliveries is/are not alive at the time of treatment; Payment for services rendered to a surrogate; Costs associated with cryopreservation and storage of sperm, eggs and embryos
